$comment: Church brand layer for HAM. Only the fields below may be customized; see ../README.md. Build: python3 design-system/tools/build_tokens.py --brand miami-temple --check

church.name: Miami Temple Seventh-day Adventist Church
church.missionLine: Reaching Up, Reaching Around, Reaching Out

colors.notes: Sampled exactly from the logo's three leaves: dark #0B9444 (primary seed), mid #39B54A, light #8CC63F.

fonts.notes: Oswald echoes the heavy condensed MIAMI TEMPLE wordmark; Inter for everything else.

onDark.use: App bar (always dark ink --ham-bg-appbar), dark photos, dark splash. The original, official artwork.

onLight.use: White or light surfaces: sign-in card, requester pages, emails, PDF reports, public scoreboard embed. Only the wordmark is recolored (to #111814); the leaves are unchanged.

mark.use: Favicon / PWA icon, compact app bar on mobile detail screens, system-message avatar.
